diagnostics_bundle.decision: HUMAN_TODO q-15 (native save dialog), q-16 (host hardware allowed in new evidence)
diagnostics_bundle.rule: Loomward's first file write: diagnostics.preview builds a redacted allowlist bundle (typed fields only; no path, name, volume label or key, process, label, collection name, receipt or message; unread values are explicit unknowns) and holds its exact bytes; diagnostics.save (desktop only, every session) writes exactly those bytes, only for the matching digest, to a file the owner picks in a Rust save dialog; the path never crosses IPC; relative, network, device, verbatim, device-name and stream targets refused, a parent folder that resolves to a network path refused (local junctions are followed), and a final component that is a link, reparse point or not a regular file refused; temporary file renamed over the target; an existing file is replaced only after Loomward's own Cancel-default confirmation; no upload; commands.json effects owner_picked_export for this command only
diagnostics_bundle.not_yet: no person has driven the real save dialog or the replace confirmation yet; automated tests reach them only through stand-ins (no probe leg covers them)

personal_duplicates.rule: a personal session reads file contents in its own active owner grants (the scan's root gate and fences) to confirm duplicates: same size, partial hash, full hash, byte comparison; pinned, revalidated, non-elevated, no-recall handles; placeholders and offline files skipped, never hydrated; reparse points not followed; rows without a 128-bit identity never read; candidate cap before I/O; byte and time budgets; revocation stops reads and redacts the report; local and read-only, nothing deleted; content_read_gated retired
personal_duplicates.not_yet: FAT/exFAT identity-unverified refusal (q-12) is a separate lane
